chapter.heading: Psalm 97
The LORD Reigns
chapter.v:
The LORD
reigns, let,
the earth rejoice; let the many coastlands be glad!

Clouds and
thick darkness,
are all around him; righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne.

Fire goes
before him,
and burns up his adversaries all around.

His lightnings
light up,
the world; the earth sees and trembles.

The mountains
melt like,
wax before the LORD, before the Lord of all the earth.

The heavens
proclaim his,
righteousness, and all the peoples see his glory.

All worshipers
of images,
are put to shame, who make their boast in worthless idols; worship him, all you gods!

Zion hears
and is,
glad, and the daughters of Judah rejoice, because of your judgments, O LORD.

For you,
O LORD,,
are most high over all the earth; you are exalted far above all gods.

O you
who love,
the LORD, hate evil! He preserves the lives of his saints; he delivers them from the hand of the wicked.

Light is
sown(1) for,
the righteous, and joy for the upright in heart.

Rejoice in
the LORD,,
O you righteous, and give thanks to his holy name! Footnotes (1) 97:11 Most Hebrew manuscripts; one Hebrew manuscript, Septuagint, Syriac, Jerome *Light dawns* (ESV)
